data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a sustainable catch plan? With 100 tons now, I propose 18 tons each this month. That leaves 10 tons, so next month we’ll have either 100 or 20—not a guaranteed refill. For future months, let’s cap our combined catch at the available stock minus 5 tons, splitting the whole-ton allowances as evenly as possible and rotating any extra tons. At 20 tons, for example, we’d take 3 each. I’ll commit to my allowance if everyone agrees, and we can review the revealed catches together each month. John, would you support that?
